notes: SECTOR 7 — A complete first-person stealth infiltration game built with Three.js and WebGL. Features: solid first-person controls with pointer lock, acceleration/damping, collision detection with sliding and step-up, crouch/jump/run mechanics; view-model with animated hands and functional flashlight (battery system); authored multi-room facility with distinct areas (entry corridor, security checkpoint, server rooms, central hub, storage, admin offices, core chamber, exit); 7 AI enemies with patrol/investigate/chase/attack states, vision cones, hearing, and line-of-sight checks; complete game loop (title → onboarding → play → fail/win → restart) with saved best times; stealth system with visibility, noise, and light penalties; HUD with objectives, timer, detections, alert level, stealth %, flashlight battery, keycards; procedural textures, materials, and all audio synthesized via Web Audio API; post-processing (bloom, FXAA); settings (sensitivity, volume, FOV, quality, invert Y) persisted to localStorage; gamepad support; reduced motion support; WCAG AA contrast; no external assets — fully self-contained in index.html.
